NEGROS POWER ADVISORY
MANUAL LOAD DROPPING (MLD) SCHEDULE 
October 28, 2026 (Wednesday)/9:25 AM
Due to the alert levels declared by the National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP) today, Distribution Utilities (DUs) in the Visayas, including Negros Power, have been directed to implement possible power interruptions through Manual Load Dropping (MLD). 
As per NGCP, in their advisory today via https://https://www.facebook.com/share/p/1DyHuyj6Cq/, 10 plants are on forced outage in October, 2 plants since September, 2 plants since August, 1 plant since June, 3 plants since May, 3 plants since 2025, 1 plants since 2024, 2 plants since 2023, and 1 plant since 2021, while 18 plants are running on derated capacities, for a total of 804.3MW  unavailable to the grid.
Factor/s that contributed to the RED and YELLOW Alert declaration:
1. Unavailability of Visayas’ large coal plants TVI 1, TVI 2, and KSPC 1.
2. Limited power imports from Mindanao due to the planned outages of GNPK 4 and TSI 2
At present, the following feeders are being considered for possible MLD implementation (refer to the photo provided). In the meantime, the following are the actual areas that are currently offline:
Alijis Feeder 2
Time offline: 4:48pm
Time online: 6:34pm
Affected Areas: "Portion of Alijis Road (Alijis Substation to areas before Maranatha Christian Academy), Greenplains Subd., Araneta Street, Magsaysay Ave. to SRA, Luxur Place (former Bacolod Convention Plaza and Hotel), Teleperformance, Bacolod City Police Station, Goldenfield Commercial Complex, Magsungay, Jose R. Torres Elementary School, Henrietta Village, Airport Subd., Calong-Calong, Villa Esperanza, Palmas Del Mar, Orient Marine, Villa  Servando, Golden River Village
(824) San Sebastian St. (Locsin - Mabini),Lacson St. (San Sebastian St. - Abad Bridge), UNOR-IS, Planta Hotel, Civil Service Commission Negros Occidental Field Office, Portion of Brgy. 39, Regency Plaza Tourist Inn, Southville Subd, Montalbo Gym., Abad Santos St., Moran St."

(Buri-Circumferential - Front All Home),
---------------------------------------
Alijis Feeder 1
Time offline: 5:39pm
Time online: 6:59pm
Affected areas: "
Portion of Alijis Road (Alijis Substation to areas Araneta Ave), Bacolod Girl’s Home, Prk. Pag-asa, Akina Village, South Residences, Araneta Highway (Monark Eqpt.  down to Medalla Elem. Sch.), Villa Cristina Subd., Prk. 8 Baybay
Gardenville Subd., Florenceville, Manville Royale"
------------------------------------------
Please be advised that the schedule, duration, and affected feeders may change at any time, depending on the actual condition of the power system and/or further directives from NGCP.
Negros Power continues to closely coordinate with NGCP and will provide updates as necessary.
To know which feeder you are connected, please refer to the link: https://www.facebook.com/share/p/18oNLoVaqA/
For the latest information and updates, please refer to the official posts of Negros Power on our Facebook page. We encourage the public to regularly check our official posts for any changes to the MLD schedule, affected feeders, and other related advisories.
We sincerely ask for your understanding, patience, and cooperation as these measures are being implemented to help maintain the stability of the power grid.
